title: 彗·画一汪晴天
description: 长发画师彗穿完整宽袖衣，在院中画一小片晴空，巨大画笔靠着画架而不施放攻击。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Hwei is a slender adult Ionian male artist with very long dark hair, a pale contemplative face, and a flowing painter's robe in muted blue-green tones. Preserve the distinctive broad brush and colorful hanging pigments, adding a fully covering layered inner garment and opaque legs. His large brush is an artistic tool resting beside the easel, with no threatening ink creatures.
art_direction.scene: He sits in a small courtyard and adds a pale blue cloud to an unlettered sheet on a low easel using an ordinary small brush. A shallow puddle nearby reflects the same gentle sky shape. Keep his expression absorbed but peaceful, the large signature brush leaning safely nearby, and the background a simple wall and one plant.
art_direction.palette: ink blue, sage green, pale sky, muted coral
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
